pick.subtitle: {{category}} templates

wizard.title: Create orders
wizard.missingHint: Only what is not in stock is ordered. Never below the minimum order quantity; ordering more needs an explanation.

wizard.previewHint: One order per supplier; the numbers become final when created.

wizard.previewHintMerge: One order per supplier: if a supplier already has a draft order in this BOM that has not been sent, the lines are added to it — the others get a new order.

wizard.linesAdded_other: {{count}} lines added to the existing order

purchases.title: Orders
purchases.empty: This BOM has no orders yet

purchase.quoteNumberPlaceholder: The number the supplier gave us
purchase.quoteNumberHint: Printed on the PDF as «Your quote no.». Without it the PDF cannot be sent and the order cannot be confirmed.
purchase.quoteFileHint: The supplier's price quote (PDF or image) — required before confirmation.
purchase.dropHint: Drop the file here or choose one
purchase.requestHint: The price request carries only product name, model and quantity; no quote PDF or order number is needed. Send the PDF and e-mail from the request's own page. It never becomes an order — orders are placed after the BOM is approved.

receipt.title: Goods receipt
receipt.hint: Enter the quantity received. Scan one serial number per piece for serialised products — the moment they enter the warehouse they are reserved for the project with the earlier delivery date.
receipt.serialPlaceholder: Scan or type a serial no. ↵
receipt.duplicateSerial: This serial number is already in the list

documents.title: Documents

ai.fillButtonTitle: Give the supplier's lines, PDF or image — the template's empty cells are filled
ai.noColumns: The template has no column to fill — pick a template with more columns under «{{tab}}»
ai.title: Fill the table with AI
ai.subtitle: The template's empty cells are filled from matching lines — no rows or columns are added.
ai.fixedNote: ERP code, product name and quantity stay as they are.
ai.dropHint: PDF, Excel or image · or paste with {{keys}}

ai.readingNote: Images are read as a table first; this can take a moment.
ai.nothingToFill: The document has no value for the empty cells
ai.rowsLocked: BOM order: rows are fixed — never added or removed; the template's empty cells are filled.

request.title: Price request
request.buttonTitle: Ask suppliers for prices before approval — product name, model and quantity are sent
request.linesHint: A price request carries only product name, model and quantity — no prices, ERP code, quote PDF or order number. The quantity comes from the BOM and can be changed.
request.supplierHint: A product can go to several suppliers — pick as many as you like. Each supplier gets its own price request.
request.supplierNotSaved: A supplier added here is used for this request only — it is not added to the product card.
request.previewHint: Each supplier gets its own price request; numbers are final once created.
request.resultHint: The price requests were created as drafts. Send the PDF and e-mail from the request's own page. A price request never becomes an order — orders are placed after the BOM is approved.
request.failed: {{supplier}}: price request could not be created

revision.label: Rev.{{revision}}
revision.historyEmptyHint: When the BOM is approved it is recorded as Rev.0.
revision.startSubtitle: Rev.{{current}} stays in force; the changes are prepared in draft Rev.{{next}}.
revision.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the customer changed the capacity, different compressor model…
revision.ruleKeeps: Until approval Rev.{{current}} stays in force: reservations and orders do not change.
revision.ruleOrders: On approval every affected order is shown one by one; an order at the supplier never changes silently.
revision.ruleArchive: Rev.{{current}} is kept on record and can be opened at any time.
revision.discardText: The changes in the draft are lost. Rev.{{current}} stays in force as it is.
revision.draftingHint: Until approval Rev.{{current}} applies: reservations and orders stay unchanged. Save your changes, then «Approve revision».
revision.requestTitle: Price request for the revision lines
revision.noOrders: This change does not affect any order.
revision.toOrderHint: These lines are ordered after approval via «Create orders».
revision.staleRequests: {{count}} price requests ({{list}}) are marked as belonging to the old revision (Rev.{{revision}}).
revision.reopensBom: The BOM was completed — after approval it is «Approved» again and is completed again once the new confirmations are in.
revision.reopensMain: The main BOM {{number}} is «Approved» again as well.
revision.approveSubtitle: Rev.{{from}} → Rev.{{to}}: BOM, reservations and orders are updated together.
revision.orderPending: This order was updated by a BOM revision (order Rev.{{revision}}, BOM Rev.{{bomRevision}}): send it to the supplier again and upload the new confirmation (PDF).
revision.requestStale: This price request belongs to the old revision (Rev.{{revision}}); the BOM is at Rev.{{current}}.

actionText.UPDATE: Not sent to the supplier yet: the lines change directly, no revision needed.
actionText.REVISE: {{number}} keeps its number and becomes Rev.{{revision}}. The old PDF and the supplier confirmation are archived; send the order again and upload the new confirmation (PDF) — until then it is no longer confirmed.
actionText.DELETE: All lines of this draft (never sent) were removed from the BOM: the order is deleted.
actionText.CANCEL: All lines were removed from the BOM but the order is at the supplier: it stays as it is. Clarify the cancellation with the supplier and delete the order; if the goods arrive anyway they go to free stock.
actionText.KEEP: The order stays (the supplier does not accept the reduction): the surplus goes to free stock and can be reserved for other projects.

revision.staleRequests_one: 1 price request ({{list}}) is marked as belonging to the old revision (Rev.{{revision}}).
